lines.text: …I was walking home from the convenience store. I saw him under the bridge. That’s all. Can I go home now?
You look terrified. Nobody here thinks you did this. What really happened tonight?

…You really don't think it was me? Then… I'll tell you. It was earlier. Around ten-fifty, I was on the bridge, and I heard a tiny bell ringing from underneath. High-pitched, like a charm… Then someone with a dark umbrella walked away along the riverbank. I couldn't see their face. I hid in a bus shelter for an hour before I dared to look.
From behind…? So the person with the umbrella… they came up behind him and he didn't even turn around. Like he knew them. …I still don't understand any of this.

Seiran… that's my school. That's why I didn't want to say. Ishida-sensei… he was my teacher. He gave me private maths lessons at his house, secretly — the school forbids outside tutoring. That night he texted me at nine-forty: 'Sorry, Yuki. Cancel tonight. Someone from the old days wants to talk.' …It felt wrong, so I went toward his house over the bridge. Here, look at my phone.
